definitions.explanation: To resolve a personal conflict or disagreement and restore a friendly relationship. Used for interpersonal reconciliation.

definitions.gloss: to settle (a dispute); to reach a settlement
definitions.explanation: To reach an agreement to resolve a legal dispute outside of a formal court judgment. A legal term for out-of-court settlement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{和解|わかい}した。
⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{冷戦|れいせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、ようやく{和解|わかい}すること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: After a long cold war, they were finally able to make peace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利|き}いていなかった→利く：11845_kiku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仲介|ちゅうかい}→仲介：09718_chuukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{和解|わかい}した。

notes:
USAGE:
⟦{和解|わかい}→和解：10578_wakai⟧ has two main uses: personal reconciliation (sense 1) and legal settlement (sense 2). In everyday conversation, sense 1 is more common. In news and legal contexts, sense 2 appears frequently.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和解|わかい}する (to reconcile / to settle)
- ⟦{和解|わかい}→和解：10578_wakai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}する→成立する：25497_seiritsusuru⟧ (a settlement is reached)
- ⟦{和解|わかい}→和解：10578_wakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じる→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧ (to agree to a settlement)
- {和解金|わかいきん} (settlement money)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{和解|わかい}→和解：10578_wakai⟧: reconciliation or legal settlement
- ⟦{仲直|なかなお}り→仲直り：03127_nakanaori⟧: making up (casual, personal conflicts)
- ⟦{示談|じだん}→示談：23317_jidan⟧: out-of-court settlement (specifically between parties without court involvement)
- ⟦{調停|ちょうてい}→調停：14251_choutei⟧: mediation (formal third-party intervention)
